thing-type.label: Stookwijzer Location
thing-type.description: Stookwijzer advice for a location in the Netherlands, configured using RD New coordinates. Provides wind speed, air quality index and burning advice (yellow/orange/red) per 6-hour time block.

channel.label: Advice Time Block 0-6 h
channel.description: Burning advice for the first time block (0 to 6 hours after model run).

channel.label: Advice Time Block 6-12 h
channel.description: Burning advice for the second time block (6 to 12 hours after model run).

channel.label: Advice Time Block 12-18 h
channel.description: Burning advice for the third time block (12 to 18 hours after model run).

channel.label: Advice Time Block 18-24 h
channel.description: Burning advice for the fourth time block (18 to 24 hours after model run).

channel.label: Advice Final Time Block 0-6 h
channel.description: Whether the advice for time block 0-6 h has been finalised.

channel.label: Advice Final Time Block 6-12 h
channel.description: Whether the advice for time block 6-12 h has been finalised.

channel.label: Advice Final Time Block 12-18 h
channel.description: Whether the advice for time block 12-18 h has been finalised.

channel.label: Advice Final Time Block 18-24 h
channel.description: Whether the advice for time block 18-24 h has been finalised.

parameter.name: rdX
parameter.label: RD New X Coordinate
parameter.description: X-coordinate of the location in the RD New system (EPSG:28992), in metres. Valid range for the Netherlands: 7000 - 300000.

parameter.name: rdY
parameter.label: RD New Y Coordinate
parameter.description: Y-coordinate of the location in the RD New system (EPSG:28992), in metres. Valid range for the Netherlands: 289000 - 629000.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval (minutes)
parameter.description: How often data is fetched from the RIVM WMS service. Stookwijzer updates every 6 hours; 30 minutes is recommended.

channel-type.label: Postal Code (PC4)
channel-type.description: 4-digit postal code area for which the advice is calculated.

channel-type.label: Model Run Timestamp
channel-type.description: Date and time when the model calculation was run (format: dd-mm-yyyy hh:mm).

channel-type.label: Air Quality Index (LKI)
channel-type.description: Calculated Air Quality Index (LuchtKwaliteitsIndex) for the first time block. -1 = no value available; 1 = good; 11 = very poor.

channel-type.label: Wind Speed (m/s)
channel-type.description: Average wind speed in the first time block (0 to 6 hours after model run), in metres per second.

channel-type.label: Wind Force (Beaufort)
channel-type.description: Average wind force in the first time block (0 to 6 hours after model run), in Beaufort. At wind force 2 or below, Stookwijzer always issues a red advice.

channel-type.label: Wind Direction
channel-type.description: Wind direction in degrees (0-360). -1 means no value available.

channel-type.label: Burning Advice
channel-type.description: Burning advice as a colour code: -1 = no advice, 0 = yellow (caution), 1 = orange (better not to burn), 2 = red (do not burn).

channel-type.label: Advice Finalised
channel-type.description: Indicates whether the burning advice for this time block is final (ON = final, OFF = may still change). An advice is finalised at most 6 hours before the time block starts.
